title: 第5章 御兽典第6章 火牙狗
lines: 第5章御兽典
过了一分钟。
母亲音量比正常时候大了几分，面部表情却很平静：“我去趟厕所。”
工作人员道：“前面左拐到尽头再往右就看到了。”
母亲点点头，抬腿朝右边走去。
“女士，是往左边。”工作人员提醒道。
母亲的背影僵硬了一下，随后当做没有发生过的样子转向左边。
这让乔桑有点哭笑不得，她控制了一下上扬的嘴角。
妈，你坚强独立女性的人设崩了啊。
她转头看向火牙狗们，心思重新回到了它们身上。
乔桑发现，火牙狗爱动，精力旺盛，竟没有一只是安安静静呆着的。
新人御兽师将小胖鸠它们做为首选的宠兽真的不是没有道理……
乔桑忍不住问道：“有没有性格安静一点的火牙狗？”
工作人员委婉道：“其实我们基地还有很多其它的宠兽。”
乔桑秒懂。
她毕竟灵魂是个成年人，就算没有御兽的经验，她也不觉得她会像15岁的孩子一样对只脾气不温顺的宠兽没有办法。
既然如此，不要管性格，干脆选只有眼缘的火牙狗。
“我能看看那只吗？”
乔桑注意到那只火牙狗一直在对着一棵树撞击着，并不是那种横冲直撞地向树撞击，而是蓄力有目的性的撞击。
乔桑觉得它的目标不是树，是它自己。
毕竟谁会傻乎乎地没有目的性地往树上撞？
“当然。”工作人员回答道。
“嘟嘟！”她拿起挂在胸前的铁质哨子放在嘴边发出刺耳的声音。
所有的火牙狗都停下了动作，视线全部集中了过来，不再搞破坏。
有几只火牙狗脑袋一歪。
是开饭了吗？
没了火焰的阻碍，工作人员走进火牙狗基地中抱起被挑中的火牙狗。
火牙狗眨了眨迷茫的眼睛，火焰般的招风耳动了动。
火牙狗被放到乔桑面前。
火牙狗是一种小型的犬类宠兽，烈焰般红色的毛发，伴着几条黑色条纹，头顶有一撮橙橘色的短毛。
眼前的火牙狗身高60公分左右，体型明显比其它火牙狗要小上一圈，额头还有着刚刚撞击留下的伤痕，黑色的瞳仁湿漉漉地看着她，看着有种让人很想摸一摸的冲动。
瞧着不像其它的火牙狗一样火暴，反而有点可怜的感觉。
乔桑脑海里已经自动脑补了一只弱小的火牙狗被排挤，食物被抢然后营养不良，最后拼命锻炼的辛酸史。
刚刚撞击树肯定是想练习什么绝技。
比如烈焰冲击之类的。
工作人员介绍道：“这只火牙狗是我们基地目前这边年纪最小的，才出生不到一个月。”
原来不是弱小是年纪小……
不过小好啊，许多御兽师培育宠兽会选择在它还是蛋的时候，这样培养往往很容易跟宠兽建立起感情跟默契。
乔桑先前也产生过买颗幼兽蛋的想法，不过很快便被她否决了。
毕竟她现在还要上学，不可能带着颗蛋去学校，既引人注目又不安全。
content_en:
Chapter 5: Beast Control Manual
A minute passed.
The mother's voice was a little louder than normal, but her facial expression was very calm: "I'm going to the toilet."
The staff member said: "Turn left ahead to the end and then go right and you will see it."
Mother nodded, raised her legs and walked to the right.
"Ma'am, go to the left." the staff reminded.
The mother's back stiffened for a moment, and then she turned to the left as if nothing had happened.
This made Qiao Sang feel dumbfounded, and she controlled the raised corners of her mouth.
Mom, your persona of a strong and independent woman is broken.
She turned to look at the Fire Fang Dogs, and her thoughts returned to them.
Qiao Sang discovered that the Huoyang dogs were active and energetic, and none of them stayed quietly.
It’s not unreasonable for new beast masters to choose little fat doves as their first choice pet beasts...
Qiao Sang couldn't help but ask: "Is there a fire-toothed dog with a quieter personality?"
The staff member said politely: "Actually, there are many other pet animals in our base."
Qiao Sang understood instantly.
After all, her soul is an adult. Even if she has no experience in controlling beasts, she doesn't think she will be as helpless as a 15-year-old child against a pet beast with an untamed temper.
In this case, don't worry about the personality, just choose the fire fang dog who only has eyes.
"Can I see that one?"
Qiao Sang noticed that the fire-toothed dog had been hitting a tree. It was not a rampant hit against the tree, but a purposeful hit with force.
Qiao Sang felt that its target was not the tree, but itself.
After all, who would be so foolish as to crash into a tree without any purpose?
"Of course." the staff member replied.
"Beep!" She picked up the iron whistle hanging on her chest and put it to her mouth to make a harsh sound.
All the Fire Tooth Dogs stopped moving and focused their attention, no longer wreaking havoc.
Several fire-toothed dogs tilted their heads.
"Teeth?"
Is it time to eat?
Without the hindrance of the flames, the staff walked into the Fire Tooth Dog Base and picked up the chosen Fire Tooth Dog.
"Teeth?"
The fire-toothed dog blinked its confused eyes, and its flaming wind-catching ears moved.
The Fire Tooth Dog was placed in front of Qiao Sang.
The Firefang is a small canine pet with flaming red hair, a few black stripes, and a tuft of short orange hair on its head.
The fire-toothed dog in front of her was about 60 centimeters tall, and her body was obviously smaller than other fire-toothed dogs. There were scars on her forehead from the impact. Her black pupils were looking at her with wet eyes, which made people want to touch her.
It doesn't look as fiery as other fire-toothed dogs, but it feels a bit pitiful.
Qiao Sang's mind had automatically filled in the bitter history of a weak Fire Tooth dog who was squeezed out, robbed of food, malnourished, and finally exercised desperately.
He must have been trying to practice some stunt when he hit the tree just now.
Such as flame impact and the like.
The staff introduced: "This fire-toothed dog is the youngest one at our base currently, and was born less than a month ago."
It turns out that he is not weak but young...
But it's a good thing. Many beast masters will choose to cultivate their pet animals when they are still eggs. In this way, it is often easy to establish a relationship and a tacit understanding with the pet beast.
Qiao Sang also had the idea of ​​buying a cub egg before, but she quickly rejected it.
After all, she still has to go to school, and there is no way she can go to school with an egg. It would be both eye-catching and unsafe.
